name: Team Fortress 2
description: Team Fortress 2 dedicated server (Steam app 232250), installed and updated with SteamCMD. Allow about 20 GB of disk and at least 2 GB of memory.
startup_command: export HOME=/home/container; ./srcds_run -game tf -console -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +ip 0.0.0.0 -strictportbind -norestart +map {{SRCDS_MAP}} +maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +tv_port {{TV_PORT}} +hostname "\"${SERVER_NAME}\"" $( [ -n "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ] && printf '+sv_password %s' "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ) $( [ -n "${RCON_PASSWORD}" ] && printf '+rcon_password %s' "${RCON_PASSWORD}" ) $( [ -n "${STEAM_TOKEN}" ] && printf '+sv_setsteamaccount %s' "${STEAM_TOKEN}" )

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map the server starts on, for example cp_dustbowl, ctf_2fort, pl_badwater, koth_harvest_final or mvm_decoy.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Highest number of players that can be connected at once. Valve only supports up to 32; more is experimental.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser. A hostname line in cfg/server.cfg overrides it. Letters, numbers, spaces and _ . , : ! # ( ) + @ - only.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console tools, which connect to the game port over TCP. Leave empty to keep RCON disabled.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: Optional 32 character token (GSLT) for app 440 from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers. It gives the server a permanent identity so players keep it in their favourites.

variables.name: Update On Start
variables.description: Check Steam for a server update every time the server starts. Turn it off to start faster or to stay on the installed build.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. Used by the installer and by the update on start; do not change it.
